title: RFK Jr picks seven new members for US CDC vaccine panel, document shows
summary: Health secretary had previously fired all 17 members of panel and chosen eight handpicked advisers to join in June US health secretary, Robert F Kennedy Jr, has chosen seven new members for the Centers for Disease Control and Prevention’s panel of vaccine experts, an internal CDC document showed on Wednesday. The Department of Health and Human Services has directed the CDC to name the new members to its advisory committee on immunization practices (ACIP), according to the document, which was seen by Reuters.
